quote: I have had the pleasure of working with Harriet in both a role where I was a candidate, as well as utilizing her to help me fill an open position. In both instances, I found Harriet to be extremely responsive, making sure the process moved smoothly for both the candidate and hiring manager. She does a great job of listening to what both sides are looking for, ensuring there is alignment between both parties. I highly recommend her services.

I had the pleasure of working with Adam during our search for a Sales Director for the Americas this year. Adam quickly demonstrated a deep understanding of our needs, grasping the specifics of the role and aligning perfectly with our expectations. His extensive network, market knowledge, and efficiency were key to filling this critical position in just a few months. Adam's ability to access candidates we wouldn't have reached on our own made all the difference.

I worked with Harriet throughout 2023, to find new hires into my team. Harriet is a gifted recruiter; exceptionally driven, responsive and an impressive ability to understand her clients need. Her awareness of her market is remarkable and this allowed her to identify exactly the type of people we were looking for. In the interactions I had with potential hires, they all spoke highly of her diligence and tenacity.

I have had the pleasure of working with Adam a number of times over the past several years. Not only a good human being, but he definitely does a great job matching roles to candidates. Not only has he supported me in finding roles for my own career, but he has also brought in high-level candidates for teams I have built in the past. Highly responsive and diligent, I can recommend working with Adam if you are looking to bring new talent into your team, or if you are looking to make the next step in your own career.

I worked with Harriet in recruiting some very critical positions for my team and was extremely pleased with her engagement and service levels. She makes a lot of effort to understand the business requirements and suggests the right candidates which makes the job of a recruiting manager a lot easy. It was indeed a pleasure working with Harriet and she will be my first port of call in future.

Adam is an outstanding business partner; he has extensive industry knowledge and is constantly innovating to provide an elevated client and candidate experience. Adam builds long term client relationships, he does not support "one size fits all" but takes time to understand business needs, budget constraints and long-term company goals and will tailor a strategy/timeline to meet your talent acquisition needs. I highly recommend Adam as an external recruiting resource for large staffing buildouts, niche sourcing support and individual hiring needs.

Harriet has been a pleasure to work with. She is very responsive and has a very good understanding of the CDMO landscape. This understanding allows her to be a valued partner as she understands what it takes for a candidate to be successful in this industry.

Adam has been a tremendous help in being a great resource for Vector Laboratories. When hiring talent was challenging because we were competing with large companies and with VC-backed companies, Adam was able to convey our value proposition to talent and help us fill a number of roles. What I appreciate most about working with Adam on finding talent is that Adam has an appreciation and understanding of our company culture to seek the best fit candidates. I highly recommend working with Adam and look to work with him in the future when we have continued growth in talent.

I have had the pleasure of working with Adam over the past few years, and I can confidently say that he is an exceptional headhunter in the healthcare/IVD sector. His industry knowledge/network and keen eye for talent have consistently impressed me. Adam's dedication to matching the right candidates with the right opportunities is unparalleled, making him an invaluable asset in the recruitment process. I highly recommend him to anyone seeking top-tier talent in healthcare.
